curated_records.source_title: Compound AI Systems: Why Multi-Agent Orchestration Outperforms Monolithic LLMs
curated_records.excerpt: State-of-the-art results are increasingly obtained by compound systems with multiple components (LLMs, retrievers, code interpreters, validators) rather than a single monolithic model. Modular verification and self-correction reduce error propagation by over 60%.

curated_records.source_title: Deterministic UI Rendering vs Diffusion Models: The Typography Problem
curated_records.excerpt: Generative image diffusion models inherently introduce text hallucinations and font blurring. Combining programmatic Chromium headless rendering with LLM-structured JSON yields 100% crisp, error-free typography at $0 compute cost.

curated_records.source_title: Local Small Language Models in Production: 3B Parameters with Tool Calling
curated_records.excerpt: Fine-tuned 3B to 8B parameter models running on-device or on consumer GPUs achieve 98% accuracy on structured JSON generation while slashing cloud API expenses to zero.

curated_records.source_title: Context Window Degradation: Why Truncation Trumps Bloated Contexts
curated_records.excerpt: Injecting over 32k tokens of unstructured context causes attention dilution where reasoning accuracy drops by 34%. Pre-filtering data through deterministic scoring layers preserves reasoning fidelity.

curated_records.source_title: Self-Correcting Agentic Pipelines: Bounded Loops vs Runaway Retries
curated_records.excerpt: Unconstrained retry loops in agentic software lead to recursive hallucinations and quota exhaustion. Implementing strict 2-attempt revisions with fallback heuristics resolves 91% of edge-case failures safely.
Separating agent knowledge (beliefs) from goals (desires) and active execution plans (intentions) produces deterministic workflows that withstand asynchronous environment disruptions.

curated_records.source_title: The Death of Top-of-Funnel Fluff: How Evidence-Led Content Wins B2B Buyers
curated_records.excerpt: Enterprise decision makers ignore generic thought-leadership carousels. Content citing specific architectural tradeoffs, benchmarks, and production failure modes converts at 4.2x higher rates into enterprise pipeline.

curated_records.source_title: Save-and-Share Mechanics: The Psychology of Reference-Grade Carousels
curated_records.excerpt: Instagram algorithm prioritizes Saves and DMs over Likes. Users save content that functions as permanent reference material—cheatsheets, failure post-mortems, and architectural blueprints.

curated_records.source_title: GPU Cluster Economics: The Real Cost of Training vs Inference in 2026
curated_records.excerpt: Inference compute now consumes 82% of enterprise AI budgets. Teams that migrate from proprietary model endpoints to quantized open weights on edge inference chips cut monthly cloud spend by $40k+.

curated_records.source_title: Meta Graph API v23 Changes: Stricter Quotas and Direct Content Publishing
curated_records.excerpt: Meta has transitioned developer APIs toward server-to-server container creation. Unofficial scraping and session-hijack bots face immediate account bans, making official Graph API pipelines essential for longevity.

curated_records.source_title: From Code Monkey to Systems Architect: The 2026 Engineering Transition
curated_records.excerpt: When AI writes 70% of routine syntax, high-earning engineers differentiate through orchestration, threat modeling, schema governance, and deterministic verification gates.

curated_records.source_title: The Zero-Debt Automation Stack: Building Pipelines That Run Themselves
curated_records.excerpt: Building production pipelines that cost $0.00/mo and survive upstream API outages requires stateless design, local fallback engines, and automated health monitoring.

curated_records.source_title: Why 90% of Fine-Tuning Projects Are a Waste of Capital
curated_records.excerpt: Most enterprise teams fine-tune models to inject facts—a fatal mistake. Fine-tuning alters tone and style; retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and tool calling inject facts with 10x higher fidelity at 1% of the cost.

Traditional social media marketing agencies rely on manual copywriters and Canva designers who burn out after 30 days. Autonomous deterministic pipelines deliver higher signal consistency at zero marginal cost.
